research_question: Can one causal industry-level d5 continuation failure exit preserve the Industry-Consensus Q1 return source while reducing failed-industry tail losses?

hypothesis_origin.consumed_2024_2025_anatomy: The temporal-transfer failure was upstream selected-industry absolute continuation, while within-industry stock selection retained relative value.
hypothesis_origin.preceding_failed_rule: The frozen 10% entry veto failed because overextended events had higher mean payoff but worse severe-loss incidence in both 2018-2020 and 2021-2023.
hypothesis_origin.interpretation: Do not remove the high-payoff entry family; test whether an observed post-entry industry continuation failure supplies a natural risk exit.

frozen_baseline.selection: exact causal-numeric-erratum Industry Diffusion plus Weekly Low-MAX same-industry Q1 pair
frozen_baseline.capital: at most one-half pre-entry NAV, equal across executable names, cash only

single_candidate_rule.name: INDUSTRY_D5_CONTINUATION_FAILURE_EXIT
single_candidate_rule.checkpoint: After the fifth completed holding-session close, including the entry session as day 1.
single_candidate_rule.feature: Compound five causal daily equal-weight simple returns of all eligible rows in the selected PIT industry from entry_index through entry_index+4.
single_candidate_rule.action: Exit the entire surviving event pair at the next legal sellable open, entry_index+5 or later if blocked.
single_candidate_rule.nontriggered: Keep the exact h20 due-open exit.
unchanged: signal, diffusion, Low-MAX, Q1 pair, and same-industry entry requirement
next-open entry and one-half-NAV event capital
equal weights, no leverage, and no backfill
T+1, price limits, suspensions, QD-010 corporate actions

evaluation.replay: exactly one dynamic-exit replay only if every screen gate passes

prohibited: d3, d10, d15, or neighboring checkpoint
nonzero return threshold or threshold grid
entry filter, Top-N, pair, capital, or weighting change
market-state, recurrence, saturation, or concentration rule
